evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/clm-s740/<planId>/ with gate runs under tmp/clm-s740/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/. Retry loops write <name>-1.log..<name>-3.log and copy the green attempt to <name>.log. tmp/ holds only .log, .txt, .json and .jsonl data, never binaries or .ts files, and at most 300 files per plan. Cargo output goes to target/ (artifactRoots ["target"] in every plan). target/clm-s737-before/nodetto-cli is the timing reference. target/clm-baseline/nodetto-cli must never be deleted (no cargo clean).

openDecisions.blocks: Nothing in this manifest. Depth-one output stays unchanged, and depth-one containment is not reported as met for conflict inputs.
openDecisions.effectOnPlans: clm-09a documents the limitation without naming Q11. No plan pins a conflict input. clm-09-wiring keeps the exact Q11 line in its progress log and final report.

reviewContext.userProblem: clm-09-wiring is partial: full help and docs, CLI-level and git merge-driver end-to-end tests, native parity tests, manifest gates, native timing and final stable-tree verification are outstanding.
requiredOutcomes: Full help and docs for every new command, mode, flag, op and field.
Git merge-driver end-to-end test with a temporary repository and .gitattributes merge=nodetto; a missing git fails.
Native parity tests for new commands and flags, with more than 0 tests run.
CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass, with up to 3 attempts on native deadlines.
Native timing against target/clm-s737-before/nodetto-cli, plus arrange timings, recorded.
Q11 depth-one behavior kept and documented.
nonGoals: Redesign, or changes to decisions D1, D2 or D3'.
Feature logic; a defect in a feature module is a finding for its owning plan.
Implementing Q11 Option A, or pinning the Q11 reproduction in a test.
Rust changes and MCP schema changes.
Changing defaults of tidy, overlaps, edit --arrange, move or frame carry.
Relaxing any deadline; binary-less native parity; pushes, tags, releases; server, auth or deployment code.
Strict noUncheckedIndexedAccess diagnostics that exist only in test files outside clm-09's scope.
constraints: Strict TS, noUncheckedIndexedAccess-safe production core, Boa rules (no regex split on whole documents, no per-point destructuring in hot loops).
Neutral self-authored fixtures only; no external issue numbers, organizations, reporters or downstream names.

Every plan: fresh read before each edit, pre and post git hash-object in its own progress log, edits only its paths, no state-changing git commands, no worktrees, no broad formatters, no lockfile changes.
AGENTS.md: English, no emojis, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo.
apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/*.json may be rewritten by mise run verify and is never staged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Split clm-09 into three wave 1 tracks and one wave 2 final-gates plan.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Registration is in the tree, so the tracks need no handover. Only final gates and timing need the complete tree.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Only clm-09c builds and runs native tests in wave 1.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One cargo build at a time, and no competing deadline tests.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Q11 is documented and reported, not resolved.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: workflowInput says to keep current behavior, document it and not block, without choosing a final option.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: harness.ts gains one additive compareFile export.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Three new topic files need the same fresh-copy comparison for commands that write; compare stays unchanged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: README carries every name and both recipes and links docs/cli.md for the per-kind tables.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps the README readable while docs/cli.md holds the complete tables.

intentionalTradeoffs: A help assertion that clm-09a breaks outside its own tests is fixed in wave 2, so plans need no hand-off.
Repo-wide typecheck in wave 1 reads siblings' in-progress files and may fail transiently.
supportedEdgeCases: E2.1 refusals exit 2 and write nothing.
A conflicting git merge keeps canonical ours with no conflict markers.
--quiet never hides match lines, conflict lines or errors, and --strict --quiet exits 3.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Depth-one conflict inputs until Q11 is answered.
Layered and route arrange for sequence, breadboard and pcb pages (excluded, with reasons in help).
residualRisks: Q11 open: depth-one containment not accepted for conflict inputs
The new tests may expose a feature defect, which becomes a finding for its owning plan and keeps the gate red.
A Rust host defect has no pre-authorized path, because Rust changes are a non-goal, and would need a blocker report.
Native deadline tests may fail under load after 3 attempts; deadlines are never relaxed.
mise run verify may rewrite tracked apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/*.json; commits stage explicit paths only.
